6797-7084-8337.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, M'Ress triggers, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

5254-6495-7741.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-6495-7741.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
5254-6495-7741.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

6495-7435--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Repeat.
6495-7435--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3764-4659-7363.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Mutagen.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
3764-4659-7363.notes: As mana allows, you can instead sacrifice the Mutagen token to its own ability.

792-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
792-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Totentanz and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2511-2730-3175.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3532-3949-5078-6556.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3949-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

341-5078-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

431-1308-2557-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-2557-4365.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1850-2573-4693.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-2573-4693.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

198-1954-4067-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {W} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Change of Heart with buyback by paying {3}{W}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +4/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Change of Heart.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

224-872-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
If the land enters untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

880-2374-4826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2374-4826.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1809-2061-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
1809-2061-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Returned Pastcaller.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1142-1429-2034-3644.description:
Activate Lazav by paying {2}, choosing to have it become a copy of Lesser Masticore if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, or Young Wolf otherwise.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazav, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazav dies, if it was a copy of Lesser Masticore, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Otherwise, Lazav's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lazav enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

526-2232-2469-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nonartifact creature token.
526-2232-2469-4050.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought by paying {1}.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating a copy of any nonartifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Phyrexian Dreadnought to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Phyrexian Dreadnought trigger from sttep 2, doing nothing.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4694-5394.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill an artifact creature you control.
4694-5394.description:
Kill an artifact creature you control.
Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
The Clue enters the battlefield as a 0/0 artifact creature due to March of the Machines, and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

97-2173-5220.description:
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing itself.
When Ravenous Baloth dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ravenous Baloth on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ravenous Baloth ability, causing you to gain 4 life.
Cast Ravenous Baloth from the top of your library by paying 4 life.
Repeat.

1633-2060-2445-4120-5032.description:
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from the top of your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

1734-2292-3175.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

591-927.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Jon Irenicus triggers, giving control of Serendib Djinn to an opponent who controls no lands.
When Serendib Djinn's controller controls no lands, Serendib Djinn triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Serendib Djinn cannot be sacrificed due to its ability.
Serendib Djinn triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

825-2060-4153-4331.description:
Cast Clay Champion by paying six {G}.
Clay Champion enters the battlefield with nine +1/+1 counters on it.
Clay Champion entering the battlefield triggering its last ability, to no effect.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Clay Champion from the battlefield to your hand.
Clay Champion leaves the battlefield, triggering Resourceful Defense, putting all counters that were on Clay Champion on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability eight times by removing eight +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U} and seven {G}.
Repeat.

262-603-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Galvanic Juggernaut.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
262-603-5256.description:
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating five 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Elemental.
The Elemental dies, triggering Galvanic Juggernaut, untapping Galvanic Juggernaut.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Elemental's power.
Repeat.

575-1388-4489.description:
Cast Mistcutter Hydra for {X} = 0.
Mistcutter Hydra dies due to having zero toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning it to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate that Forest adding {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down Mistcutter Hydra, and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.
